issues.explanation: Chapter 88 ends with Meng Huo’s third capture and release. In source chapter 89, the next capture is explicitly called the fourth (孟優 says “被擒了四次”), but the adaptation calls it the fifth, creating an off-by-one continuity error.
issues.suggested_fix: Change “孟獲第五次被擒” to “孟獲第四次被擒” (or omit the ordinal).
